events.name: Carolina Panthers at Arizona Cardinals

venue.fullName: Tom Benson Hall of Fame Stadium

lastPlay.text: (Shotgun) C.Beck pass short right to S.Fehoko for 5 yards, TOUCHDOWN.

events.name: Carolina Panthers at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: — Baker Mayfield and the Tampa Bay Buccaneers find themselves in the uncomfortable position of rooting for the New Orleans Saints. The Carolina Panthers are pulling for the Atlanta Falcons.
headlines.shortLinkText: Baker Mayfield and the Buccaneers beat the Panthers 16-14, stay alive in chase for NFC South title

events.name: Seattle Seahawks at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: — The Seattle Seahawks are heading into the playoffs with the NFC's No. 1 seed, and even more important, a defense that proved it can stop even the most potent offenses in the league.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks secure No. 1 seed in NFC and division title with dominant 13-3 win over 49ers

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Atlanta Falcons
Cleveland Browns at Cincinnati Bengals

headlines.description: — Myles Garrett wanted to get his 23rd sack and set the NFL's single-season record in a victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Garrett sets sacks record and Szmyt's field goal on last play gives Browns 20-18 win over Bengals

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Minnesota Vikings

headlines.description: — J.J. McCarthy had a productive first half before he was injured again, fullback C.J. Ham rushed for a short touchdown, and the Minnesota Vikings finished a frustrating season by beating the resting Green Bay Packers 16-3 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Vikings cruise past resting Packers 16-3 for 5th straight win as McCarthy exits again with injury

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at New York Giants

headlines.description: — New York Giants owner John Mara got a season-ending gift from his team three months into his cancer treatment.
headlines.shortLinkText: Owner John Mara gets a game ball after Giants beat the Cowboys 34-17 in season finale

events.name: Tennessee Titans at Jacksonville Jaguars

headlines.description: — Trevor Lawrence's teammates gave him a light-hearted present in the locker room after the quarterback broke the franchise record for total touchdowns in a season and led the...
headlines.shortLinkText: Streaking Jaguars clinch AFC South title with a 41-7 drubbing of Titans

events.name: Indianapolis Colts at Houston Texans

headlines.description: — The playoff-bound Houston Texans got their starters some rest on Sunday and the backups helped them get another win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Texans win 38-30 over Colts, clinch No. 5 seed in AFC playoffs

events.name: New York Jets at Buffalo Bills
Detroit Lions at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: — Jared Goff and the Detroit Lions entered the season with their sights set on the Super Bowl. Finishing a frustrating year by beating their division winner was at least some consolation.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lions beat playoff-bound Bears 19-16 on Bates' 42-yard field goal as time expires

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: — Ja'Quan McMillian goofed up the play in practice, got an earful from Denver defensive coordinator Vance Joseph and then made good when given another chance Sunday when it mattered most.
headlines.shortLinkText: Broncos secure AFC's top playoff seed with 19-3 win over Chargers

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Las Vegas Raiders

headlines.description: — Daniel Carlson, a pending free agent, might have earned himself a contract either with the Raiders or another NFL team.
headlines.shortLinkText: Daniel Carlson hits 60-yard field goal to lift Raiders over Chiefs, 14-12

events.name: Arizona Cardinals at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: — To prepare for the playoffs, the Los Angeles Rams dressed their starters for a fairly meaningless regular-season finale against an opponent that hadn't won in two months.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stafford throws 4 more touchdown passes, and Rams beat Cardinals 37-20 to secure No. 5 NFC seed

events.name: Miami Dolphins at New England Patriots

headlines.description: — Last season when the Patriots faced the Los Angeles Chargers, New England trudged off following a 40-7 loss in one of its final games before Mike Vrabel was hired as coach.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rhamondre Stevenson scores 3 TDs and playoff-bound Patriots beat Dolphins 38-10

events.name: Washington Commanders at Philadelphia Eagles

headlines.description: — Nick Sirianni understood the risks associated with his decision to rest Jalen Hurts, Saquon Barkley and most of the Eagles' key starters with the No. 2 seed in the NFC at stake.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eagles’ backup plan backfires with 24-17 loss to Commanders that costs them shot at NFC's No. 2 seed

events.name: Baltimore Ravens at Pittsburgh Steelers

headlines.description: — The way Aaron Rodgers looks at it, part of his job is to be a “magnetic force."
headlines.shortLinkText: Rodgers and Steelers win AFC North, beating Ravens 26-24 after Loop misses kick at buzzer

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: — Puka Nacua stepped into the huddle with the Los Angeles Rams trailing by four with 2:38 left, the home crowd roaring and his team's season on the line.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stafford's late TD pass to Parkinson lifts the Rams past the Panthers 34-31 in tense playoff opener

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: — Caleb Williams dropped back, pump-faked and found DJ Moore wide open down the sideline for the go-ahead touchdown.
headlines.shortLinkText: Caleb Williams rallies Bears from 18 points down for 31-27 playoff win over rival Packers

events.name: Buffalo Bills at Jacksonville Jaguars

headlines.description: — Josh Allen took a pounding and doled out punishment — looking every bit like the reigning MVP.
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Allen carries Bills to 27-24 win at Jags for Buffalo's first road playoff victory in 33 years

events.name: San Francisco 49ers at Philadelphia Eagles

headlines.description: — Jauan Jennings hid his eyes behind sunglasses, but could not hide his emotions with the San Francisco 49ers set to play an NFC postseason rubber match in Seattle.
headlines.shortLinkText: Purdy, 49ers eliminate defending Super Bowl champion Eagles with 23-19 win in wild-card game

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at New England Patriots

headlines.description: — Patriots coach Mike Vrabel talked to his team about being prepared to bleed as New England entered its first playoff game since the 2021 season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Maye throws late TD pass and Patriots' defense roughs up Herbert, Chargers in 16-3 playoff win

events.name: Houston Texans at Pittsburgh Steelers

headlines.description: — Sheldon Rankins is well-versed in the Houston Texans' nondescript playoff history. The veteran defensive tackle is hell-bent on writing a different ending this time.
headlines.shortLinkText: Texans stifle Aaron Rodgers and the Steelers 30-6 for franchise's 1st road playoff win

events.name: Buffalo Bills at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: — The Denver Broncos wrangled their biggest win in a decade from Josh Allen and the Buffalo Bills but suffered an enormous loss in the process.
headlines.shortLinkText: Broncos reach AFC title game after 33-30 win over Bills, but lose Nix for season with ankle injury

events.name: San Francisco 49ers at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: — Rashid Shaheed returned the opening kickoff for a touchdown, Kenneth Walker III rushed for three scores and the Seattle Seahawks advanced to the NFC championship game with a dominant 41-6 victory over the San Francisco 49ers on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks dominate 49ers from opening kick, advance to NFC title game with 41-6 win

events.name: Houston Texans at New England Patriots

headlines.description: — Mike Vrabel returned to New England on a mission to have the franchise playing again in meaningful games in January — as he did so often as a player.
headlines.shortLinkText: Maye throws 3 TD passes, Stroud has 4 INTs as Patriots top Texans 28-16 to advance to AFC title game

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: — Matthew Stafford and Sean McVay shot knowing glances at each other, then went to work on the drive that got the Los Angeles Rams one step away from the Super Bowl.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rams shake off wild, late TD pass by Caleb Williams, beat Bears 20-17 in OT to reach NFC title game

events.name: New England Patriots at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: — Drake Maye handled the sloppy, snowy conditions better than the home team and he scored New England’s only touchdown on a 6-yard keeper,...
headlines.shortLinkText: Patriots punch ticket to 12th Super Bowl with gritty 10-7 win over Broncos in snowy Denver

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: — Sam Darnold was cast aside by the New York Jets, who drafted him No. 3 overall in 2018. The Minnesota Vikings didn't bring him back after he led them to a 14-3 season but flopped in the playoffs.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sam Darnold and Seahawks advance to Super Bowl with thrilling 31-27 win over Rams in NFC title game
